record.title: Evaluate recovered stock readiness before RF collection
record.intent: Release the fixed comparison only from actual fresh stock evidence or close the recovery with a precise stop.
requirements: Independently assess the operator-confirmed power cycle, fresh captured lease, unique stock process/boot/mapping/policy evidence, current normal UI, warm-up, protected corpus and host/capture closure. Neither responsive CH1 nor SCPI identity substitutes for native policy verification.

If accepted, bind a fresh ArmReady projection to the immutable actual recovery and independent review; reconcile the original acquisition, reduction and determination inputs before admitting further execution. Keep all 75-slot acquisition and numerical criteria unchanged. On failure preserve the exact question answered, do not repeat reset or connect, and state the smallest next operator decision.

Commit and push the conclusion before another experiment. Preserve original stock and derived bytes and the hard deadline; do not claim a recovered transport, preparation or synthetic control is an RF characterization result.
acceptance: A reasoned recovery decision releases the original protocol or holds it with exact evidence.

review.rationale: Reviewed the preparation conditional post-root readiness revision and observation reconciliation. The decision still evaluates actual fresh stock evidence or an explicit stop, with independent capture/lifetime/preservation review. One conditional daemon restart plus one post-root readiness sequence is not a retry permission. Revalidation changes no RF slot, selection, source, threshold, warm-up or deadline and makes no claim that recovery has succeeded.
